scope: Detector validation grid only; no test-driven selection; descriptive estimates

setup.legacy_metric_fields: yes_minus_no/logp_yes/logp_no denote positive-minus-negative/positive/negative answers, regardless of answer spelling
setup.condition_definition: Yes: gradient recording; No: no_grad; both eval, no activation probe

model_provenance.scope: Local config provenance only; not a checksum of all model weights

setup.method: Fixed execution features; ridge correction of existing answer rows only
setup.head_replay_protocol: All-vocabulary native parity on every cached baseline input and every final cached input; native shape/stride/offset/dtype; intermediate updates replay existing head
setup.ridge_selection: Minimum validation full-vocabulary CE; exact ties favor stronger ridge
setup.fit_targets: Individual answer logits from fixed pair mass and signed log odds

preservation.constraint: Both fitted answer logits retain pre-fit native values; many phase only
